checks.title: Name the target user and painful problem
checks.action: State the user, the job, the painful problem, and the desired outcome in plain language.
patterns: target (?:user|customer|market)|\bICP\b|ideal customer profile|job to be done|customer problem|user pain

checks.title: Talk to potential customers
checks.action: Interview prospects and record their exact words, objections, and buying intent.
patterns: customer (?:interviews?|discovery|validation)|user (?:interviews?|research|validation)|interview (?:notes?|transcripts?|questions?)|survey responses?|30\+ potential customers|ask 1[–-]3 existing customers

checks.title: Define the smallest useful version
checks.action: Write the functional scope, build the smallest path to the desired outcome, and list the remaining work.
patterns: minimum viable product|\bMVP\b|smallest version|one[- ]week (?:app|build|hackathon)|functional requirements|scope (?:the|out) (?:MVP|build)|first 20 customers

checks.title: Prepare a clear website
checks.action: Prepare a public website that explains the problem, outcome, offer, and next step.
patterns: https?://[^\s)]+(?:vercel\.app|pages\.dev|netlify\.app)|landing page copy|website structure|website template|hosted website|published website|deployed website

checks.title: Prepare a working interactive demo
checks.action: Prepare a working demo that shows the main outcome, not only screenshots or a promise.
patterns: interactive demo|live demo|product demo|demo day|working prototype|product walkthrough

checks.title: Make first value easy to reach
checks.action: Prepare onboarding, a quick start, and a short path to the first useful result.
patterns: onboarding|first value|time[- ]to[- ]first[- ]value|quickstart|quick start|getting started|installation guide|walkthrough

checks.title: Prepare payment or waitlist handling
checks.action: Prepare a checkout, paid waitlist, or another clear way for a person to commit.
patterns: stripe\.checkout|checkout session|payment (?:system|flow|collection)|pricing plan|price[_ -]?id|pricing page|paid waitlist|waitlist signup|sign.?up page

checks.title: Measure traction
checks.action: Track customers, revenue, waitlist size, usage, retention, and other evidence that people value the product.
patterns: \bMRR\b|\bARR\b|waitlist (?:of|with|has)|revenue[:= ]|users? (?:signed|joined|active)|customers? (?:signed|paying)|conversion rate|retention|churn|traction

checks.title: Prove quality and operational safety
checks.action: Add tests, deployment checks, privacy and terms, backups, access control, and safe handling of customer data.
patterns: unit tests?|integration tests?|end[- ]to[- ]end tests?|pytest|vitest|playwright|cypress|github/workflows|continuous integration|\bCI\b|privacy policy|terms of service|security policy|backup|restore|mfa|2fa|encryption|rate limits?|deployment pipeline

checks.title: Close the customer feedback loop
checks.action: Collect customer questions, sales calls, support issues, and feature requests, then use them to change the product and message.
patterns: customer feedback|user feedback|support tickets?|sales calls?|customer interviews?|what_the_market_is_telling_us|feature requests?|churned customers|record every sales call

checks.title: Prepare the investor story
checks.action: Prepare a clear deck, one-page summary, or deal memo that explains the problem, product, market, evidence, and ask.
patterns: pitch deck|investor deck|data room|one[- ]pager|deal memo|fundraising deck|investor narrative

checks.title: Show investor-grade traction
checks.action: Show a short history of customers, revenue, growth, retention, or other demand evidence with dated numbers.
patterns: \bMRR\b|\bARR\b|traction|customers? (?:paying|signed)|revenue[:= ]|waitlist (?:of|with)|retention|churn|conversion rate|growth rate

checks.title: Prepare the financial plan
checks.action: Prepare projections, costs, use of funds, runway, and a budget that match the raise target.
patterns: financial projections?|use of funds|cash flow|runway|burn rate|\bP&L\b|profit and loss|financial model|budget

checks.title: Prepare legal and ownership records
checks.action: Prepare the cap table, incorporation records, founder and IP agreements, and prior funding documents.
patterns: cap table|certificate of incorporation|founders?[' ]? agreement|IP assignment|term sheet|\bSAFE\b|shareholders? agreement|board minutes

checks.title: Prepare the diligence data room
checks.action: Collect the deck, financials, contracts, bank records, IP records, and other diligence evidence in one controlled place.
patterns: data room|due diligence|customer contracts?|bank statements?|patent documentation|prior SAFEs|deal memo

checks.title: Prepare the raise process
checks.action: Set the target, stage, valuation, investor list, meeting cadence, and response speed.
patterns: fundraising|raise (?:a |the )?(?:seed|pre-seed|angel|round)|valuation|investor (?:list|outreach|process|meeting)|lead investor|use of funds|target raise

checks.title: Check opportunity eligibility
checks.action: Track the deadline, location, sector, founder, company, and other eligibility rules for every target opportunity.
patterns: eligibility|eligible (?:entity|applicant|founder|company)|application requirements?|submission requirements?|selection criteria|judging criteria|deadline

checks.title: Prepare application assets
checks.action: Prepare the working prototype, requirements, summary, budget, and documents that the application needs.
patterns: functional requirements?|technical requirements?|prototype|working demo|application (?:materials?|assets?)|one[- ]page (?:pitch|summary)|project (?:summary|description)|budget

checks.title: Prepare the demo-day pitch
checks.action: Prepare a short live demo, pitch deck, presentation script, and answers for the judges.
patterns: demo[- ]day|judge(?:s|ing)|pitch (?:video|deck|script)|presentation (?:deck|script)|live demo|elevator pitch

checks.title: Complete and check the submission
checks.action: Prepare every required file, follow the format rules, submit early, and keep the confirmation.
patterns: submit(?:ted|ting)? (?:an |the |your )?(?:application|proposal)|application (?:form|deadline|requirements?|materials?)|proposal (?:form|deadline|requirements?)|required documents?|submission checklist

checks.title: Validate demand before building the message
checks.action: Find existing demand and real buying signals before investing in a content or launch plan.
patterns: demand (?:already )?exists|demand validation|validate demand|market demand|customer demand|preorders?|preorders?|250\+ emails|public buying intent

checks.title: Write the launch plan
checks.action: Set the date, audience, message, channel, sequence, and success measure before launch day.
patterns: launch date|launch plan|launch checklist|pre[- ]?launch|prelaunch|viral launch|go[- ]to[- ]market|post[- ]launch

checks.title: Prepare launch assets
checks.action: Prepare the launch copy, product video, founder introduction, demo, landing page, and creator briefs.
patterns: loom|introduce yourself|founder video|video introduction|launch film|product video|demo video|creator brief|launch copy

checks.title: Pre-sell the outcome
checks.action: Offer a waitlist, preorder, deposit, or paid commitment before the full product is ready.
patterns: waitlist|pre[- ]?sell|pre[- ]?order|presell|preorder|deposit|payment collection|paid waitlist|checkout

checks.title: Build an owned audience and community
checks.action: Choose where the audience gathers, collect contacts, and give the community a clear reason to return.
patterns: community|discord|circle|whatsapp group|email list|newsletter|skool|audience|followers

checks.title: Run repeatable daily distribution
checks.action: Post, reply, and reach out every day for long enough to learn which messages create demand.
patterns: post daily|daily post|daily content|cold email|linkedin.{0,30}post|reddit|reply (?:to|with)|build in public|outbound

checks.title: Turn customer results into proof
checks.action: Capture customer results as case studies, testimonials, quotes, reviews, and founder stories.
patterns: case stud(?:y|ies)|testimonial|social proof|customer quote|customer reviews?|user reviews?

checks.title: Design a zero-budget revenue engine
checks.action: Use service-first delivery, customer revenue, free distribution, and cash flow before outside funding.
patterns: zero[- ]budget|no money|no funding|bootstrapp\w*|free tools?|cash[- ]flow|customer revenue|cold outreach.{0,20}week|first 10 customers|first customer
